cells.gaps: No source gives a share or a count of district offices connected, and none says in its own words who provides or pays for a district office's connection: the only explicit statement is the 2012 instruction (RWA-026), which prescribes and reports no office as connected, so `institutional` rests on district offices working in national systems. The government network linking districts is a plan (RWA-011), cells are reported without internet (RWA-006, RWA-008) but are sub-offices, and no dated event on district offices falls in the twelve months.
cells.note: District offices work in national systems held elsewhere (civil registration in 2024 and 2025, IFMIS, building permits), which is live use outside the capital. Stage 4 needs a share of districts from a source that also states the institutional connection, and none is published.
